class.name: BehaviorTreeComposite
class.brief_description: Base resource for behavior tree tasks containing ordered children.
class.description: The [member tasks] array holds child [BehaviorTreeTask] resources. Resources are shared between agents; [BehaviorTreeRunner] owns execution state. Cyclic references and null child tasks are rejected. Use a [BehaviorTreeSequence] or [BehaviorTreeSelector] for execution.

method.name: add_task
method.description: Adds a child task to the end of the list.

method.name: get_task_count
method.description: Returns the number of direct child tasks.

method.name: get_tasks
method.description: Returns a copy of the child array. Modify it with [method set_tasks] so the tree is checked for cycles.

method.name: set_tasks
method.description: Replaces the children after validating all references.
